column2: Lilmoth Dock lies north-east of here, less than a hundred paces off. Flaa Heet's village lies a little over a hundred paces to the south-west. The walled part of Lilmoth, which the map marks as Lolmoth, lies north-west, more than two hundred paces away.
Three dead Dunmer lie at the east end of Lilmoth Dock, about a hundred paces north-east of here. They still carry their weapons and their purses.
I fight with a blade in each hand. I also do the bargaining for the three of us.
We are three Argonian sellswords, a brawler, a fire mage and a swordsman. We stand together here on the shore track, south-west of Lilmoth Dock.
